messages:
katie: hey all — re: last night’s paging storm, want to land a tighter post-incident flow. a couple gaps in follow-ups + handoff clarity. can we sketch an automated pipeline?

samir: yes please. the issue: actions were tracked in a mix of google docs, TODOs in the postmortem doc, and a spreadsheet. nobody owned the action-tracker dashboard, so items drifted. also handoff notes were clipped by the oncall summary. :face_with_raised_eyebrow:

li: agree. we should auto-create canonical action tickets and assign a temporary owner during the oncall handoff. maybe reuse the incident id as a prefix.

paul: +1. What about a safety net to re-escalate untriaged PMRs after 7 days? we had three items that never got triaged.

elaine: I'd like a standard template for the PMR that includes: customer-impact-rubric, mitigation timeline, triggered alerts, and a short RCA section. also a clear "owner until closure" field.

katie: proposed flow:
- incident-bot posts incident thread + short oncall summary
- at post-incident close, incident-bot auto-generates a PMR skeleton using template v2
- ops-automation-bot creates action tickets in tracker (label: pmr/<incident>) and assigns "oncall-owner" for 48h
- dashboard shows outstanding items, owner, due date, and triage state

samir: sounds good. can we get a sample payload incident-bot would emit? that’ll help infra implement. e.g. minimal JSON it should emit to webhook.

li: sample below — minimal fields we need:
```
{
  "incident_id": "INC-2026-0423-1123",
  "summary": "504 spike affecting hosted API",
  "start_ts": "1861231200",
  "end_ts": "1861234200",
  "customers_impacted": ["acme", "beta-co"],
  "oncall_owner": "katie"
}
```

paul: with that we can have ops-automation-bot run a small task to create tickets. we should also include a severity and a customer-impact-tag (minor/major/critical) for filtering.

ops-automation-bot: auto-action: creating 3 tickets for INC-2026-0423-1123 -> pmr/INC-2026-0423-1123-1..3; temp_owner=katie; due=+7d. (this is a simulation message)

elaine: two policy asks: 1) owners must acknowledge assignment within 48h or it auto-reassigns to the team lead; 2) there should be a short templated email to affected customers drafted automatically and put in the PMR draft for SRE/product review.

katie: love both. can we add a "handoff snapshot" attachment to the PMR so oncoming oncall can see exact commands run, logs, and key excerpts? right now the summary is too high level.

samir: logs are big. suggest we attach a GCS link + a 200-line excerpt. ops-automation-bot can produce the excerpt and store full logs behind ACL.

li: implementation note: incident-bot already emits a lot of fields but not normalized. we need a converters layer: incident-bot -> normalizer -> pmr-generator -> ticket-creator -> dashboard. each step should emit events so we can trace failures.

paul: for the dashboard, we should expose these columns: incident_id, owner, triage_state, due_date, severity, customer_impact, linked_pmr_doc, last_activity_ts. make it filterable by product and by assignee.

ops-automation-bot: todo created: /ops-automation create-dashboard widget=pmr-actions cols=incident_id,owner,triage_state,due_date,severity,customer_impact,linked_pmr

katie: lifecycle rules: if triage_state==untriaged after 7d -> notify team lead and add "escalation" tag. if due_date missed -> auto-notify and add blocker flag on weekly SRE agenda.

elaine: can we tie quality regressions to the PMR? e.g., if a deployment is implicated, add a checkpoint in the deploy pipeline to block similar canaries until owner verifies fix.

samir: tricky but doable. we can emit a "deploy_block_check" event in the PMR metadata that the deploy pipeline can query.

katie: next steps:
- samir + li to draft the converter spec and sample webhook payloads (due EOD Tue)
- ops + paul to prototype dashboard widget (due next Fri)
- elaine to update PMR template + customer email snippet (due Wed)
- i'll own the orchestration RFC & run a 30m sync after specs land (inviteing infra, rel-eng, product)

li: acked. i'll post the converter gist here once ready.

samir: ack. tagging @paul for dashboard questions.

paul: acked. i'll spin up a quick mock with the tracker and share a link.

incident-bot: reminder: postmortem checklist for INC-2026-0423-1123 — PMR draft auto-created. Link: https://docs.internal/pmrs/INC-2026-0423-1123 (this is a bot notice)

katie: thanks. if folks can drop quick 👍 or comment on blockers here. i’ll consolidate into an RFC doc and PR the automation scripts.

samir: 👍

li: 👍

elaine: 👍 (left a few inline comments on the template)

paul: 👍 — will try to have dashboard mock by Thurs EOD.

katie: great. closing thread for now — updating calendar invite for sync. :calendar:
